vetSays.line: 🛡️ Willow, Antônio, Priya and Vasyl met them at the door — 4 put down. Willow, Antônio, Priya are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
The Pack-leader The Loud Beast is on you — no warning, just teeth.
Pack-leader The Loud Beast hits you for 8.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Loud Beast (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Connor. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Connor strikes the Pack-leader The Loud Beast.
The Pack-leader The Loud Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader The Loud Beast!
📺 Connor brought down Pack-leader The Loud Beast, The Loud Beast (packmate). Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Connor brought down Pack-leader The Loud Beast, The Loud Beast (packmate). Together.
🛡️ Connor, Willow, Antônio, Naran and Oliver met them at the door — 5 put down. Connor, Willow, Antônio, Oliver are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Connor strikes the Elder The Union Rep.
The Elder The Union Rep falls.
📺 Connor brought down Elder The Union Rep, Old Gavel (picket). Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Connor brought down Elder The Union Rep, Old Gavel (picket). Together.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Priya just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Keisha just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Naran, Vasyl and Oliver met them at the door — 3 put down. Naran, Vasyl are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
The Scarred Ugly-Eyes wears Priya's face. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track you — they don't track anything.
Antônio strikes the Scarred Ugly-Eyes.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Ugly-Eyes falls.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Antônio just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Yuzhen and Milana met them at the door — 2 put down. Yuzhen, Milana are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nada just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nada, Nicole and Florencia met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Nicole, Florencia are hurt.
